'''Taska Rorn''' was one of the crewmembers assigned to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]''. Rorn's duties included navigational and helm duties, and she was on duty in the ship's command center when the ship was hit by a [[lightstorm]] in the [[Kathol Rift/Legends|Kathol Rift]].
